title: AFP, US Pacific Command, Canadian Armed Forces successfully conduct 20th MMCA in Sulu Sea
intro_html: CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City  -- The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), United States Pacific Command (USPACOM), and Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) successfully conducted the 20th Multilateral Maritime Cooperative Activity (MMCA) from September 12 to 13, 2026, in the Sulu Sea.
image_caption: BRP Suluan (MRRV-4406) and HMCS Regina (FFH 334) display coordination at sea with BRP Diego Silang (FFG7) during the Division Tactics/Officer of the Watch Maneuver Exercise for the 20th MMCA on 13 September 2026, in the Sulu Sea.
body_html:
CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City -- The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), United States Pacific Command (USPACOM), and Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) successfully conducted the 20th Multilateral Maritime Cooperative Activity (MMCA) from September 12 to 13, 2026, in the Sulu Sea.

The activity enhanced interoperability among participating forces, strengthened maritime security, and supported information-sharing and coordination. It also contributed to a safer and more peaceful region by improving the participating forces’ shared understanding of activities at sea.

The AFP deployed BRP Diego Silang (FFG7), one Sokol search-and-rescue (SAR) aircraft, and one Black Hawk helicopter. The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) participated through BRP Suluan (MRRV-4406).

The CAF deployed HMCS Regina (FFH 334), while the USPACOM participated with a P-8A maritime patrol aircraft.

The MMCA featured a series of maritime and air activities, including Communications Exercise (COMMEX), Division Tactics (DIVTACS) and Officer of the Watch (OOW) Maneuver Exercise, and Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA).

The successful activity underscored the Philippines’ commitment to strengthening partnerships with like-minded countries and enhancing collective capabilities in support of a secure and rules-based maritime environment.///

Photos by: PO3 Gonzales PN and A1C Castro PAF/ PAOAFP
